guidedTourSteps.label: Platform overview
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Open the portal for the first time
guidedTourSteps.outcome: See the operating flow, module scope, capabilities, and phased rollout plan.

guidedTourSteps.label: Secure onboarding
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Create users and send first-login access
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Each employee enters through role-based access, 2FA, and audit-friendly sessions.

guidedTourSteps.label: Project setup
guidedTourSteps.trigger: A new construction job is awarded
guidedTourSteps.outcome: The portal creates one source of truth for BOQ, phases, deadlines, team members, and progress.

guidedTourSteps.label: Daily field capture
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Work is completed on site today
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Supervisor input becomes an engineer-verified official report with photos and attachments.

guidedTourSteps.label: Management approval
guidedTourSteps.trigger: A report, document, material request, or invoice needs sign-off
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Approvals move through the correct chain with comments, reminders, escalation, and audit records.

guidedTourSteps.label: Inventory & Stores
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Materials or tools move between warehouse and project site stores
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Warehouse and site stock, tagged tool locations, supplier context, and governed movement workflows.

guidedTourSteps.label: Mobile execution
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Users work from site on low bandwidth
guidedTourSteps.outcome: A PWA-friendly flow keeps drafts, photos, approvals, and notifications usable on phones.

guidedTourSteps.label: Launch path
guidedTourSteps.outcome: MVP scope, acceptance scenarios, migration inputs, and deployment model are defined.

productTourSteps.title: Operations overview
productTourSteps.body: The operations pulse shows company-wide KPIs: active projects, pending approvals, late updates, document status, stock levels, and unread alerts.
productTourSteps.instruction: Approved field activity updates these KPIs automatically. Managers see pending approvals, late reports, and risk signals in one view.

productTourSteps.title: Operating domains
productTourSteps.body: The portal covers daily site reporting, approval management, document and version control, and inventory and stores management as integrated workflows.
productTourSteps.instruction: Each domain connects to the core operating flow: project baseline, field capture, verification, approval, and company record.

productTourSteps.title: Platform capabilities
productTourSteps.body: Daily reporting with structured field capture. Approval workflows with role-based routing. Document control with active-version enforcement. Financial tracking at the project level. Mobile field use with offline support.
productTourSteps.instruction: Every capability connects field execution to management visibility through governed workflows.

productTourSteps.title: End-to-end operating flow
productTourSteps.body: The flow connects project baseline, site field capture, engineer verification, PM approval, and the final company record.
productTourSteps.instruction: Every module connects to this core flow: project baseline, field capture, verification, approval, and company record.

productTourSteps.title: Requirements coverage
productTourSteps.body: Each documented module is mapped to its implementation phase (MVP, Phase 2, Phase 3, Operations) and described in terms of final-product behavior.
productTourSteps.instruction: All documented modules are covered with clear scope by phase.

productTourSteps.title: First login and access control
productTourSteps.body: New users sign in with email, password, and 2FA. Admin creates accounts and assigns roles.
productTourSteps.instruction: Admin creates accounts, sends access credentials, and users complete secure first login with mandatory password change before role-based access opens.

productTourSteps.title: Role-based access
productTourSteps.body: Each screen has a defined owner, activation trigger, user action, system action, and business result.
productTourSteps.instruction: Every module has clear ownership, activation triggers, required user actions, automated system behavior, and defined outcomes.

productTourSteps.title: Operational KPIs
productTourSteps.body: The dashboard summarizes active projects, pending approvals, late updates, document status, low stock, and unread alerts.
productTourSteps.instruction: Managers see risk signals as they emerge: late reports, pending approvals, low stock, and document expiry.

productTourSteps.title: Project progress
productTourSteps.body: Project cards let managers switch between jobs and inspect progress, budget, deadlines, delayed reports, and discipline progress.
productTourSteps.instruction: Select any project to view detailed progress, budget status, discipline breakdown, and timeline.

productTourSteps.title: Project baseline setup
productTourSteps.body: Each project starts with a unique code, BOQ import or manual entry, milestones, assigned members, deadlines, and progress rules.
productTourSteps.instruction: All reports, WIRs, costs, documents, and approvals connect back to this project baseline.

productTourSteps.title: BOQ and Gantt timeline
productTourSteps.body: The Gantt timeline tracks phase planning, task owners, progress status, and delay visibility.
productTourSteps.instruction: Each task has an owner, timeline span, and real-time status connected to BOQ-approved progress calculations.

productTourSteps.title: Daily report workflow
productTourSteps.body: Supervisor updates become engineer-verified daily reports, then move to PM approval with automated PDF, email, and archiving.
productTourSteps.instruction: Field data captured by the supervisor becomes an engineer-verified, PM-approved official record with PDF export and audit trail.

productTourSteps.title: Report form sections
productTourSteps.body: The report form includes sections for manpower, equipment, materials, safety, WIR status, delays, photos, and attachments.
productTourSteps.instruction: Standardized mandatory fields ensure every report includes attendance, progress, safety, WIR status, and photo evidence.

productTourSteps.title: Report processing
productTourSteps.body: A completed report triggers approval tasks, PDF export, email distribution, dashboard updates, and permanent audit archiving.
productTourSteps.instruction: Field work becomes a management record: approval queues update, distribution is generated, KPIs refresh, and an audit trail is created.

productTourSteps.title: Approval inbox
productTourSteps.body: Approvers see report, material, document, and invoice requests with route, SLA, status, and action buttons.
productTourSteps.instruction: Each approval includes reject-with-reason, 24-hour reminders, 48-hour escalation, delegation options, and a full audit trail.

productTourSteps.title: Storage locations
productTourSteps.body: The module separates central warehouses and project site stores so managers can see where stock is held before it is issued or consumed.
productTourSteps.instruction: Warehouse and site store stock levels are visible in one system.

productTourSteps.title: Stock by location
productTourSteps.body: Consumable materials and tools show total, reserved, available, current location, and status across warehouse and site locations.
productTourSteps.instruction: Approved requests reserve quantities immediately to prevent double-issue before the Store Keeper processes physical stock movement.

productTourSteps.title: Tool and asset location
productTourSteps.body: Asset-tagged tools show their current warehouse or site, project assignment, condition, status, and last movement.
productTourSteps.instruction: Every asset-tagged tool has a current location, project assignment, and condition status so the company knows where equipment is and whether it is available.

productTourSteps.title: Movement control
productTourSteps.body: Issue and transfer requests move through approval before the Store Keeper updates stock and current location.
productTourSteps.instruction: Every issue and transfer creates an audit record, updates location, and prevents stock from going negative.

productTourSteps.title: Document control
productTourSteps.body: Documents include type, project, revision, approval status, active or superseded versioning, and searchable metadata.
productTourSteps.instruction: Field teams see the approved active version. Managers retain complete revision history, superseded warnings, and approval evidence.

productTourSteps.title: Document governance
productTourSteps.body: Document governance covers upload, review, active release, superseded warnings, and expiry reminders.
productTourSteps.instruction: Document control enforces versioning, approval gates, expiry tracking, and active/superseded rules.

productTourSteps.title: Photo evidence
productTourSteps.body: Photos are compressed, watermarked, queued for offline upload, and recoverable by Admin.
productTourSteps.instruction: Photos are linked to daily reports and stored with watermarks, compressed display versions, and original files for audit-ready project records.

productTourSteps.title: Financial tracking
productTourSteps.body: Finance covers budget versus actual, manpower cost, pending payments, invoices, payment status, and project profit and loss.
productTourSteps.instruction: Cost visibility connects directly to field reports, material consumption, documents, and approval records.

productTourSteps.title: Invoice workflow
productTourSteps.body: Invoices move from capture to accounts check, Operation Manager approval, payment status, and project cost rollup.
productTourSteps.instruction: The finance workflow tracks invoices from accounts capture through approval to project cost rollup.

productTourSteps.title: Notifications and reminders
productTourSteps.body: Notifications drive action for pending approvals, late reports, low stock, and active document updates.
productTourSteps.instruction: The system surfaces pending actions through notifications and reminders for approvals, late reports, low stock, and document updates.

productTourSteps.title: User and audit administration
productTourSteps.body: Admin manages users, inspects audit logs, and handles overrides while approved reports and historical identities remain protected.
productTourSteps.instruction: Users are deactivated rather than deleted to preserve identity history. Admin overrides are logged with reason and timestamp. Approved reports cannot be silently edited.

productTourSteps.title: Governance controls
productTourSteps.body: The portal preserves identity history, logs overrides, and keeps queryable audit evidence for sensitive actions.
productTourSteps.instruction: Identity history preservation, override logging, queryable audit trails, and protected approved records are built in.

productTourSteps.title: Mobile field flow
productTourSteps.body: The phone preview shows site users saving updates, queueing photos, and syncing when the connection allows.
productTourSteps.instruction: The mobile experience is designed for construction sites: compact forms, offline drafts, photo capture with upload queue, and sync when connectivity returns.

productTourSteps.title: Offline field work
productTourSteps.body: Mobile behavior covers offline drafts, camera capture, photo queue, sync, autosave, approvals, and active document view.
productTourSteps.instruction: Site teams can save drafts, capture photos, and view documents offline. Everything syncs automatically when the network returns.

productTourSteps.title: Deployment and delivery
productTourSteps.body: Delivery covers hosting, environments, deployment, backups, testing, migration, and acceptance scenarios.
productTourSteps.instruction: The delivery plan covers hosting, environments, deployment pipeline, backup strategy, testing matrix, and data migration.

walkthroughSteps.title: Create project baseline
walkthroughSteps.detail: Admin/Operation Manager creates project, BOQ, milestones, members, and deadlines.

walkthroughSteps.title: Supervisor submits field update
walkthroughSteps.detail: Attendance, work location, OT, progress, safety, and five site photos are captured.

walkthroughSteps.title: Engineer verifies and submits report
walkthroughSteps.detail: Engineer validates quality/WIR status, adds work summary, and submits official report.

walkthroughSteps.title: Project Manager approves
walkthroughSteps.detail: PM approves, rejects with comments, or lets the system escalate after SLA breach.

walkthroughSteps.title: System updates records
walkthroughSteps.detail: Dashboard, PDF export, email notification, audit log, documents, and costs update.
